areas.label: Frame, spill slots and registers
areas.evidence: Frame and every stack slot match. The nine loop-hoisted addresses get slots in GCSE PRE reaching-reg order = expression hash-bucket order (hash % N, N = max_cuid/2+1, see agbcc -dG 'Expression hash table (N buckets'); the original needs N=579 or 605. The current draft has N=585 (normalized diff ~216 lines); padding it to N=605 with 40 empty asm statements gives ~152 lines and the exact original slot order, so the real source has ~12 fewer (or ~40 more) RTL insns at GCSE time. The previous form (if (i > j) i = j; if (i > f26) i = 0;) reaches N=579 but cross-jumps worse (~266). 'changed' is the loop index i (r5); the level result/clamp use i and j. Remaining: bar n/bound register swap (r3/r2), bar-3 C6 store reload, ldrb+lsl/asr of f6C (draft gives ldrsb), i = j placed after (orig: before) the f26 reload in the clamp.
